rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive smart contract security analysis on the Base chain. Performs bytecode disassembly to identify dangerous function selectors, detects honeypots by simulating buy/sell via Uniswap V2, and scores rug pull risk on a 0-100 scale based on ownership concentration, liquidity depth, and dangerous permissions. Includes clone detection via Jaccard similarity on function selector sets and generates full audit reports combining all checks.
